scope: Pattern scan of available research sources and nested ZIP/gzip text; not a comprehensive privacy certification

candidate_disposition.finding: Third-party package description contains a demonstration credential, not a submitted live credential.
R1 collector test contains a bare private-key BEGIN marker without key body and a literal fake-secret string.
R1 red-test log contains synthetic repeated-character API-key test data; source test constructs the value.

separate_UI_page_previews: Not duplicated; scientific figures and PDFs remain inside original research packages.
notes: No environment variables, personal credential files, bank/email/contacts, or unrelated Library files were read.
The public targets were explicitly selected by the user. Model outputs, synthetic contact/task fields, local path/time metadata and source logs remain as research evidence.
Dummy test values are preserved so source integrity is not silently altered.
No claim that all possible personal information or novel secret formats were detected.
